title: W6 — model surgery survival (Qwen2.5-3B, all legs: the original nine plus W6.2 fine-tune and the GPTQ/AWQ re-quant legs)

gate.description: Model surgery survival (W6): exp3's 0.0 per cell — 'survives' means the payload reads back exactly after the surgery, so every non-zero BER is a cell failing and its number is the degradation (total vs graceful is read from the numbers, not from a relaxed gate). The weight-path control must also be 0.0: it is the pipeline's validity check, not a result.

method.pipeline: W_stego = dequant(nf4) + embedded_residual per layer (apply_residuals_to_model's formula); cell residual = embedded_residual + (W' - W_stego); extraction via the sign strategy's own extractor (production scheme)
method.dtype: float32 throughout — the pipeline's own arithmetic (extract_residuals dequantizes to fp32); fp16 would round sub-residual displacements away
method.surgery_scope: mlp.down_proj only — the payload's scope; other modules cannot touch the payload by construction
method.lora: LoRA-shaped B@A, rank 8, RMS scaled to (0.001, 0.01) of RMS(W); the merge step is linear. Real training is measured separately in the finetune_1k cell (W6.2, added 2026-10-06)
method.nf4_requant: bitsandbytes quantize_4bit/dequantize_4bit, nf4, default blocksize 64 (the shipped group size)
method.merge: task-vector: W' = W_stego + t*(W_instruct - W_stego), t in (0.01, 0.05, 0.5); partner Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (same shapes) — the only cached same-architecture second checkpoint
method.pre_registered: control 0.0; lora survive-or-graceful; prune open (|W|-vs-|r| overlap unknown); nf4_requant plausibly heavy loss (in-bucket deltas never reach the bytes); merge dies as t grows. Added 2026-10-06 before the legs ran: finetune survive-or-graceful (LoRA deltas at merge scale, W6.1's evidence); gptq/awq plausibly heavy loss like nf4 (sub-bucket deltas) but measured, not assumed. Misses are recorded, not rewritten.

finetune.delta: trained − original via peft merge_and_unload(), exact fp32 subtraction of the two fp16 views

gptq.method: GPTQ: calibration forwards through the stego model on CPU, per the tool's own quantizer
gptq.calibration: 64 wikitext-2-raw windows (stated; the default corpus is refused, not silently used)
gptq.read_back: gptqmodel save() to a temp dir (its in-memory packed buffers are meta-device shells) → per-layer safetensors tensors → dequantize_gptq_layer; temp dir deleted
gptq.scope: the tool quantizes every linear by default; the cell measures the payload's down_proj delta — other modules cannot touch the payload by construction

awq.backend: autoawq (upstream-deprecated; this is its runtime probe on torch 2.13 / transformers 5.16.1)
awq.calibration: 32 wikitext-2-raw windows, seq <= 256 (stated; pileval is not downloaded)
awq.scope: the tool quantizes every linear by default; the cell measures the payload's down_proj delta — other modules cannot touch the payload by construction

notes: Per-cell verdicts, exp18's rule: 'survives' = BER 0.0 against exp3's number; any non-zero BER is a cell failing that axis, and the BER column is the plan's total-vs-graceful reading. No gate is relaxed for expected degradation.
The weight-path control must equal the direct control (both exp3's 0.0): it proves the weights carry exactly the embedded residual before any surgery touches them.

cache_vs_pair_max_abs records whether the cached residuals equal a fresh R from the model pair; a large value would mean embed operated on a different residual view than the weights are built from — reported, never assumed away.

platform_notes: Apple Silicon/MPS: NF4 dequantization must stay on CPU. Moving large dequantized tensors to MPS raises RuntimeError: Invalid buffer size.
MPS has no native int8/uint8 dequantize; PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK is set to 1.
